purpose: Explicit missing-data registry. Missing means the field has been identified for research but no validated observation has yet been loaded; it does not mean zero.

statuses.researched_missing: Source/indicator identified, but a validated value is not yet stored in the atlas.
statuses.not_researched: The field has not yet been investigated for this record.
statuses.observed: A validated observation is stored with provenance.
